items.title: Idle panes give back their graphics memory
items.text: A terminal that has not drawn anything for a few seconds now releases its spare render targets and font-atlas copies, and picks them up again the moment it draws. With many panes open and most of them sitting still, graphics memory drops by more than half.

items.title: Stashed and zoomed-over panes stop drawing
items.text: A pane you stashed, or one hidden behind a zoomed pane, no longer renders every frame of its output into memory nobody is looking at.

items.title: One stuck command no longer blocks the rest
items.text: A `ghoztty +…` command that connects and goes quiet, or one that is waiting on a slow split, used to hold up every other command and every status and banner hook in every pane. Each command is now served on its own.

items.title: Quitting can't hang on a command in flight
items.text: Quitting while a command or hook was mid-flight could beachball the app. It now quits cleanly.

items.title: Closed windows leave the list at once
items.text: `ghoztty +list` no longer shows a window that has already been closed.

items.title: A crashed page comes back
items.text: If a viewer pane's web process dies, the pane reloads its content instead of staying blank until you reload it by hand.

items.title: Lighter `git-status:` panes
items.text: The live diff no longer queues up work on large repositories when one refresh takes longer than the next is due, and clicking a file no longer waits behind a refresh.
Saving the window layout no longer runs on the main thread every time a pane's banner changes, and moving the mouse over a terminal no longer redraws its whole pane.
